_about: Public-domain Vincent McNabb (1868-1943, Irish Dominican) for the Word Hoard: Oxford Conferences on Prayer (1903) and on Faith (1905), Where Believers May Doubt (1903), Europe's Ewe-Lamb (1916), From a Friar's Cell (1923), The Church and the Land (1926), The Catholic Church and Philosophy (1927) and The New Testament Witness to Saint Peter (1928), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 33 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

mcnabb-conferences-prayer: Oxford Conferences on Prayer (London: Kegan Paul, Trench, Trübner, 1903)

mcnabb-conferences-faith: Oxford Conferences on Faith (London: Kegan Paul, Trench, Trübner, 1905)

mcnabb-church-and-land: The Church and the Land (New York: Benziger Brothers, 1926)
